LESSON: KUANDIKA 11.3.1 INSHA ZA KUBUNI INSHA YA MAELEZO

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo
2. kuandika insha ya maelezo ipasavyo kwa kuzingatia vipengele vyake

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kuandika insha ya maelezo ipasavyo kwa kuzingatia vipengele vyake
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika insha ya maelezo ipasavyo kwa kuzingatia vipengele vyake. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo.
4. Show that you can: kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 11.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo
2. kuandika insha ya maelezo ipasavyo kwa kuzingatia vipengele vyake

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
